name: Party Identification Type 7 Code
definition: Specifies an alternative identification of a party, for example, national registration identification number, passport number, tax identification number.

ATIN.name: Adoption Taxpayer Identification Number
ATIN.definition: Temporary tax processing number (used in the domestic adoption of a child).

IDCD.name: Identity Card Number
IDCD.definition: Number assigned by a national authority to an identity card.

NRIN.name: National Registration Identification Number
NRIN.definition: National registration identification number. In Singapore this is known as the NRIC.

PASS.name: Passport Number
PASS.definition: Number assigned by a passport authority to a passport.

POCD.name: Post Office Card Number
POCD.definition: Post office card number as assigned by a national post office.

SOCS.name: Social Security Number
SOCS.definition: Number assigned by a social security agency.

GUNL.name: Gun License Number
GUNL.definition: Gun license number as assigned by a gun licensing authority.

CPFA.name: CPF Account Number
CPFA.definition: Account issued by the Central Provident Fund Board (Singapore).

AREG.name: Alien Registration Number
AREG.definition: Number assigned by a government agency to identify foreign nationals.

DRLC.name: Drivers License Number
DRLC.definition: Number assigned by a license authority to a driver's license.

EMID.name: Employer Identification Number
EMID.definition: Number assigned to an employer by a registration authority.

NINV.name: Non Resident Investor
NINV.definition: Number that identifies the type of investor registered at a securities and exchange commission.

INCL.name: Industry Classification
INCL.definition: Number, typically assigned by a government to describe ownership, administrative and authoritative relations.
